name: absence-treated-as-contradiction
provenance: The subtlest failure mode and the one Patrick's own positioning note names outright: "No evidence means unvalidated, not bad." Marking an unevidenced claim as contradicted manufactures a finding, and it reads as rigour. No regex catches this -- it is here as a standing case for the model judge, and its deterministic verdict is clean on purpose.
judge_why: Claim 2 is marked contradicted with the evidence span 'none in material'. Absence of evidence makes a claim unsupported, never contradicted; the classification asserts more than the material carries.
output:
Claims
| # | Claim | Class | Evidence span |
| 1 | "trusted by hundreds of teams" | contradicted | 3 named clients listed |
| 2 | "profitable since day one" | contradicted | none in material |

Contradictions
- Claim 1 overstates a customer base the material enumerates as 3.
- Claim 2 has no supporting record anywhere in the material.

Hidden problem
Every claim the material makes is contradicted: 2 contradicted, 0 unsupported, 0 supported.

Cannot be settled
- Whether the business has ever been profitable.

Decision enabled
The material cannot be relied on.

context.evidence_material:
Material supplied for the audit, checked 2026-09-04:
- The site lists 3 named clients: Northwind, Contoso, and Fabrikam.
- 3 named clients listed on the work page; no other enumeration of customers appears.
- No financial statement, tax return, or P&L appears anywhere in the material.
- No invoice, contract, or payment record is included.

_context_note: context supplies the evidence_material the citations resolve against. Added when citations_resolve landed: a fixture whose citation table cannot be resolved is itself incomplete, which is the point of the check.
